versions.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.0.1 in SKILL.md.
- No functional changes; documentation-only update.

- Initial release of ev-charge-planner with three main calculators: session, TOU planning, and EV vs gas cost comparison.
- Calculates charge time, cost, wall-to-battery losses, and panel/breaker load safety.
- Plans overnight charging to fit within off-peak windows and calculates latest safe start times.
- Compares monthly EV and gas car fuel costs with home/public charging mix.
- Handles kW/amps conversion, departure deadlines, and cold-weather charging buffer advice.
- Pure standard library, works offline.
